name: albok
description: School-wide class companion: professors publish material per class, students read it and keep lesson notes.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run backend" "npm --prefix frontend run web"
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,kiosk -c blue,magenta,green "npm run backend" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "wait-on http-get://localhost:8081 && npm --prefix desktop run dev"
scripts.test: node scripts/backend.mjs test && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
